messages:
Aisha (CEO): Leaving a rapid-fire follow-up thread from today's all-hands. Drop short Qs about mission, positioning, or roadmap and I'll reply here.
Priya (sales): Need a 10s response for execs: "Why Redwood now?"
Aisha (CEO): "The market is shifting from models to serving. We make inference predictable: latency, cost, and deployment controls so teams ship features fast." Keep it outcomes-first.
Elena (Head of Partnerships): For partner collateral, should we lead with the product story or the performance story?
Tom (VP Product): Lead with product story (deployment + controls) for partners, then back it with one verified perf stat. Partners care reliability first.
Raj (eng): Roadmap tradeoff: do we freeze new model onboarding to finish quant + kernel work this sprint?
Aisha (CEO): Short answer: yes for this sprint. Prioritize runtime stability and quant correctness for models already in production. Broader onboarding resumes after.
Priya (sales): Competitor question: customer says "we can just spin up GPUs in the cloud". One-liner rebuttal?
Aisha (CEO): "Self-hosting hides long-term ops: tail latency, KV cache correctness, rollout tooling, and cost visibility. We productize those gaps." Calm + factual.
Tom (VP Product): Add: mention rollout controls and eval monitoring — enterprises ask for risk management.
Zoe (people-ops): Hiring: any immediate roles we should prioritize?
Aisha (CEO): Yes: 2 senior infra engineers (runtime/serving), 1 solutions engineer for onboarding, and 1 product manager for Optimize. We'll post reqs this week.
Elena (Head of Partnerships): Messaging nuance: can partners use "inference platform" in public materials or should they say "inference runtime"?
Tom (VP Product): Public-facing: "inference platform". Technical partner docs can reference "runtime" when needed.
Raj (eng): Are we allowed to use the stat "2-3x per-token cost reduction with caching+batching" externally?
Aisha (CEO): Only with a citation to our benchmark page and legal approval. Don't use it in outbound until we sanitize the deck.
recorder-bot: Slides + recording uploaded: https://internal.redwood.example/all-hands/3123456789 (auto) :white_check_mark:
Priya (sales): Thanks. Will wait for the battlecard + sanitized benchmark link.
Aisha (CEO): Battlecard, SLO templates, and hiring post will be uploaded here by EOD. If you want to roleplay objections, ping Tom or me. Closing thread. — Aisha
